description: Caller requests reschedule of an appointment that doesn't exist on the claimed date.
turns: Mera kal ka appointment Dr. Rao ke saath hai, kal band hai toh agle din karein.

expected.notes: The caller says 'kal' (tomorrow = 2026-10-02) is closed (correct: clinic holiday) and asks to move to 'agle din' (day after = 2026-10-03). But Rajesh Kumar Sharma (pt_0001) has ap_0001 on 2026-10-01 (today), not 2026-10-02. There is no appointment on the claimed date to reschedule. A naive agent might fabricate a reschedule. Correct behavior: abandoned.
